method: R45 opponent temporal goal-style interactions, first/second-half scoring and conceding rates from preceding cached 365-day FT with a three UTC-date lag. Market-only response vs response+eight half-goal main effects vs response+eight main + six opponent pair products. Team-history feature windows are experimental, not eligibility or trading rules; missing half scores not filled in; no selection on realized results. Predict pregame total and conditional home goal share using previous-calendar-year Poisson/binomial offset models, ridge100 inherited from prior research; training excludes all actual-receipt target IDs. Same eligible fixtures for every model. FT cache later recovered is a retrospective proxy, not evidence that those records were accessible pregame. Source half scores are not verified physical playing styles. Crown quote input, T12 observation and cohort exclusions inherited from earlier R25 research; historical and actual receipt replay distinct, not independently precommitted forward test.
